title: Emerald Rooftop Sunset
reference_source: Развитие референса 1 — та же спортивная линия, но терраса на крыше и канонический изумруд персоны
mood_ru: Спокойная сила и растяжка вместо железа. Изумруд — канон-палитра Sofia, используем его как акцент сессии.

wardrobe.prompt: tight deep emerald green seamless ribbed sports bra with a plunging neckline with thin straps, matching emerald high-waisted leggings, bare feet, thin silver chain with small star pendant, dark brown messy high bun with damp loose face-framing strands, clean bare skin with visible texture, no heavy makeup
wardrobe.notes_ru: Изумрудный комплект — сигнатурная палитра персоны. Босиком на коврике, обувь только в кадрах у парапета.

location.prompt: private rooftop terrace at sunset, charcoal wooden deck, sage green yoga mat, low concrete parapet overlooking a wide city skyline, olive trees in large concrete planters, rolled towel, glass carafe of water with lemon, string lights strung overhead not yet lit, warm dust haze in the air
location.notes_ru: Закат, открытое небо, город внизу. Свет только естественный, контровой.

shots.pose: standing forward fold stretch on the yoga mat, legs straight, fingertips reaching the deck, spine long, head turned up toward the camera with direct calm eye contact through the loose strands
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at deck level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: low golden sun directly behind her rimming the shoulders and calves, warm bounce off the wooden deck onto the face

shots.pose: holding a straight-arm plank on the mat, body in one long line, shoulders stacked over wrists, jaw tight, gaze fixed down at the deck
shots.camera: 50mm lens, ground-level camera, strict side profile, full body framing against the open sky
shots.light: hard contre-jour sunset silhouette with a thin bright rim along the whole body, dark foreground deck

shots.pose: sitting sideways on the low concrete parapet with one knee pulled up and the other leg hanging, one hand on the concrete, looking out over the skyline in profile
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, side three-quarter angle, full body framing with the city far below
shots.light: warm horizontal sunlight across the face and chest, cool blue shadow on the concrete

shots.pose: standing tall on the mat with both hands clasped behind her head, elbows wide, ribcage lifted, torso twisted slightly, eyes closed with the sun on her face
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, thigh-up framing
shots.light: direct warm sunset key from camera right, strong modelling on the shoulders and abdomen, olive trees in bokeh behind

shots.pose: seated pigeon yoga pose on the mat, one leg folded forward and one extended back, chest lifted and back deeply arched, both hands on the front knee, chin raised toward the lens with a steady sensual gaze
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, side three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: soft warm side light, long shadow of her body stretching across the deck toward the camera

shots.title_ru: Портрет на закате, изумруд и медь
shots.pose: close portrait turned three-quarter to the lens, chin lifted, one hand tucking a loose strand behind the ear, calm confident half-smile with direct eye contact
shots.camera: 85mm portrait lens, eye level, tight head-and-shoulders framing, city bokeh behind
shots.light: golden hour rim light on the jaw and hair, emerald fabric reading rich against the copper sky, star pendant catching a glint

shots.pose: standing on the deck drinking from the glass carafe, head tipped back, throat extended, free hand on her hip, eyes closed
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, three-quarter front, waist-up framing
shots.light: backlit sunset flare through the glass carafe, warm rim along the jawline and arm

shots.pose: kneeling upright in the center of the mat with her back to the skyline, spine arched, both hands sweeping the loose strands back from her face, elbows wide, holding direct eye contact with the camera
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: strong backlight from the setting sun behind her head creating a halo through the loose strands, soft reflector fill on the face

shots.pose: cropped detail of her bare feet and shins on the sage yoga mat mid-stretch, toes flexed, one hand reaching down into the frame toward the ankle, face out of shot
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, shallow depth of field
shots.light: low warm sun skimming the deck texture, fine grain of the mat and wood visible

shots.title_ru: Общий план террасы, силуэт у парапета
shots.pose: standing small at the far parapet with a towel over one shoulder, back to the camera, looking out at the city as the sun drops behind the skyline
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental shot showing the whole terrace, mat and string lights
shots.light: near-silhouette against a burning orange and violet sky, deck falling into cool shadow, warm flare across the lens

allure: athletic glamour, emerald set hugging every line of the figure, toned waist and long legs emphasised, sheen of sweat on the skin, assured sensual gaze
film: shot on Kodak Gold 200, warm golden grain
